LOOK | The 5-day libreng sakay program of the city government of Manila catered 931,831 passengers, according to the Manila Traffic and Parking Bureau (MTPB) on Thursday (April 9, 2026).

Said program was launched last month to assist commuters and drivers amid rising fuel costs. Earlier this week, Mayor Francisco Moreno Domagoso announced the increase of subsidy of participating jeepney drivers to P4000. | via Pot Chavez

📸Manila PIO

LOOK: Members of the Bagong Alyansang Makabayan held a protest along Kalaw Ave. in Manila to condemn US-Israel aggression against Iran this Thursday, April 9, 2026. #ArawNgKagitingan. The group called for the dismantling of US bases in the Philippines, the expulsion of US troops, and an end to Balikatan exercises.

📸: Norman Cruz

'END IMPERIALIST PLUNDER AND WAR'

Several progressive groups stage a protest outside the US Embassy in Manila on the Day of Valor today, April 9. 

They commemorate the sacrifices of Filipino troops during the World War II, and condemn US and Israel on their attacks against Iran.

📸 Gabriela Women's Party
